Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 24

“Sanjaya said: Thus addressed by Arjuna, Krishna drove that magnificent chariot between the two armies, O descendant of Bharata.”

Krishna simply complies, without objection or comment — the first of many moments in the Gita where he lets Arjuna arrive at his own crisis before intervening with teaching.
